description.value: This Walmart Supercenter (Store 3057) in North Vancouver is a large-format department store carrying groceries alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, toys, and baby goods. As one of the few large retailers in the area, it offers touring cyclists a one-stop opportunity to resupply on food, household essentials, and potentially camping or outdoor supplies. The store is wheelchair accessible and has public washrooms on site.
